snippet.title: Omen Exitio: Hunger - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the launch trailer for Omen Exitio: Hunger, a Lovecraftian investigative gamebook, out now on Steam!

Get the game now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466520/Omen_Exitio_Hunger/

New York, 1927. A case pulled from real history, wrapped in cosmic horror.
His name was Billy Gaffney. The man who took him was real, but his purpose was from another plane of existence.
You play as a journalist, make choices, and the story remembers all of them.
